preconditions.description: Attacker must have sufficient tokens or ETH to interact with the Impl_Delivery function in D_Swap contract
The D_Swap contract must have funds available to be withdrawn via Impl_Delivery

exploit_hint: 1. Deploy a malicious contract with a fallback/receive function. 2. Call Impl_Delivery() function on D_Swap contract which performs an external call before updating internal state. 3. When the external call triggers your malicious contract's fallback, re-enter Impl_Delivery() recursively. 4. Repeat until contract funds are drained, as the balance/state is not updated until after the external call returns. 5. Withdraw all accumulated funds.
